video.title: Ai Corporate Infographic Poc Sales Data

scenes.narration: Welcome to our 2026 corporate performance deep dive. Today, we are analyzing a comprehensive twelve-month dataset tracking revenue, targets, and customer acquisition across four distinct geographic regions and two flagship product lines: Industrial Motors and Pumps. Let’s examine where our growth engines lie and where regional challenges demand strategic intervention.
scenes.title: 2026 Corporate Performance Overview
scenes.subtitle: Tracking Revenue, Targets, and Customer Counts Across 4 Regions and 2 Product Lines

scenes.narration: Right out of the gate, the West region emerges as our undisputed powerhouse. Throughout 2026, the West consistently crushed its targets. By December, Western Industrial Motors soared to 17.5 crore rupees in revenue—beating its target by 1.7 crore and achieving a stellar 110.8% success rate with 157 active customers.
scenes.title: West Region Industrial Motors Performance (Dec-26)

scenes.narration: It wasn't just motors driving the West. Pumps in the region mirrored that success, climbing steadily from 9.2 crore in January to 12.2 crore by December. With positive variances every single month and customer counts expanding to 114, the Western market proves to be a masterclass in consistent execution and robust demand.
scenes.title: West Pumps Growth Trajectory (2026)

scenes.narration: Moving to the South, we see a fascinating split narrative. Industrial Motors in the South gained tremendous momentum, finishing the year strong at 10.5 crore in December, outperforming targets by a full 1 crore. However, the Pumps category in the South experienced a slight drag, consistently running just below target with achievement percentages hovering between 95 and 99 percent.
scenes.title: South Region: Motors vs. Pumps (Dec-26)

scenes.narration: In the East, performance has been steady and reliable. While early months saw minor negative variances in Industrial Motors, the second half of the year turned a corner, breaking past 101% achievement by November and December. Pumps in the East held a stable baseline, closing out December at 5.9 crore with a near-perfect 98.3% target realization.
scenes.title: East Region Year-End Closing (Dec-26)

scenes.narration: Every corporate review uncovers growth opportunities, and for 2026, the North region requires our strategic focus. Both Industrial Motors and Pumps in the North faced persistent negative variances. In December, Northern Industrial Motors fell short by 0.5 crore, while Pumps lagged by 0.6 crore, pointing to fierce regional competition or shifting market dynamics that we must address.
scenes.title: North Region Deficit Analysis (Dec-26)

scenes.narration: Synthesizing our 2026 data, our enterprise demonstrates remarkable resilience and strong top-line growth, heavily propelled by the Western region and Southern motor sales. As we look ahead, our primary operational focus will be deploying targeted sales strategies in the North to close the variance gap, while scaling the winning playbooks we've perfected in the West.
scenes.heading: 2027 Strategic Priorities
content_points: Scale Western playbook across remaining regions
Deploy targeted sales interventions in the North region
Maintain southern momentum in Industrial Motors
Optimize product mix for steady regional growth
